title: llha-net: a hierarchical attention network for two-view correspondence learning
core_idea: Propose a layer-by-layer hierarchical attention network that improves two-view feature-point correspondence by reducing the impact of outliers. The method uses stage-wise channel fusion to preserve and aggregate semantic features from each stage, and a hierarchical attention module to adaptively capture and fuse global perceptual and structural semantic information. Two architectures are also introduced to extract and integrate features, increasing the network's adaptability for robust feature matching.
tldr: Introduce a hierarchical attention network with layer-wise channel fusion and adaptive attention to enhance feature-point matching robustness against outliers in two-view correspondence.
